title: Cheaper count for paginated responses
bug: `pagination.total` is capped at the page size, so clients think there is one page.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The count query now applies the same LIMIT as the page query (min(limit, max_limit)), so when offset > 0 the subquery returns fewer rows than the full result set, causing the total count to drop below the offset and the pagination logic to reject the request with a 400 error.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: Because the COUNT is executed on the limited subquery instead of the full query, pagination.total now reflects the page size (25) rather than the true total (36), which is a user-visible data change not mentioned in the PR description.
